senses.definition: (heading) Chemical elements or alloys, their ores, and the mines where their ores come from.

subsenses.definition: Any of a number of chemical elements in the periodic table that form a metallic bond with other metal atoms; generally shiny, somewhat malleable and hard, often a conductor of heat and electricity.

quotes.text: Manganism has been known about since the 19th century, when miners exposed to ores containing manganese, a silvery metal, began to totter, slur their speech and behave like someone inebriated.

subsenses.definition: Any material with similar physical properties as those chemical elements, especially as a combination of several of them, such as an alloy.

subsenses.definition: (astronomy) An element which was not directly created after the Big Bang but instead formed through nuclear reactions; any element other than hydrogen and helium.

quotes.text: Most of the matter in stars is hydrogen and helium, and the metals (including carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and so on) were cooked up inside stars.
